gate.criterion: SeedRuntime may project external artifact-store facts and runtime visibility only as a deterministic read-only observation; it must not register, consume, retain, or mutate external artifacts

boundary: This canary covers native CPU read-only SeedRuntime/store observation. It does not claim automatic registration, deletion, unlimited storage, open-domain quality, unlimited growth, CUDA, frontend behavior, Windows shell, CI completion, or general intelligence.
